messages.author: Pinky Mazumder
messages.body:
Dear Amber Users,
I need to show the 1 chain- 1 chain interactions of cellulose-
hemicellulose, cellulose-lignin and hemicellulose-lignin. By putting them
closer, I need to relax them.
So, far I am able to built the individual chain of them. However, I am
confused that how to put them closer together?
Any help would be appreciated.
Thank you.
-- 
Pinky
AL,US

messages.author: Lachele Foley
messages.body:
As Carlos said, check earlier work.  Also look for work by Jodi
Hadden.  She simulated microfibils of cellulose.
If you know the geometries you need, then you might look at the
translate and transform commands in tleap.
